cases.name: Gina C. Maiorano
cases.about: Gina was from Connecticut and had recently completed a drug rehabilitation program.
cases.narrative: On 6/5/2023, she was found dead in the breakdown lane of Interstate 89 in Hopkinton, N.H. New Hampshire State Police said he has been charged in connection with leaving the scene after she fell from the car he was driving, causing her death from blunt impact head injuries, and for violating a protective order. He claimed Maiorano "jumped" from the car while "we were driving," the court documents stated.
